subject: Demo request — pricing CTA (HivePay)

From: Elliot Brooks <elliot.brooks@hivepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request from pricing page: HivePay

Hi Jonas,

I just clicked the "Request demo" link on your pricing page after reviewing the docs. We're evaluating inference providers for a payments fraud detection feature—throughput and predictable cost are priorities. My team is running peak traffic around batch reconciliation windows and we'd like a sense of latency at scale, typical pricing for reserved capacity, and options for private deployments.

We have an initial budget range; I'd like to get a 30–45 minute demo this week or early next to see the product and pricing. I already started a trial (self-serve) and can share account details on the call.

Key context:
- Company: HivePay (payments platform)
- Role: Product Manager
- Technical attendee: Joe Chen (will join if available)
- Preferred times: Tue/Wed mornings PST (or afternoons EST)

Thanks,
Elliot
Elliot Brooks
Product Manager, HivePay
elliot.brooks@hivepay.com
(415) 555-0198
